en: In this troubled world, as I live from day to day Even then, Jesus knows my heart
Pains in the past and my gears to face tomorrow Even then Hesys knows my heart
Each day that I live is filled with joy For I know Jesus with me all the time
I bring to Him all my fears and shmaes for I know Jesus is with me all the time
I will lift my eyes to see the Lord in faith I know this too shall pass
Teach me, O Lord, to know Your will In this journey on earth each new day
